title: Schein's three levels of culture
caption: Artefacts are easy to see but hard to interpret; basic assumptions are invisible but decisive. When espoused values and assumptions differ, behaviour follows the assumptions.
alt: Three stacked layers from the visible top to the hidden base: artefacts, espoused values, basic underlying assumptions.
description: Top, visible: artefacts such as dress, office layout, stories and rituals.
Middle: espoused values, the stated values, strategies and goals.
Base, invisible: basic underlying assumptions, the taken-for-granted beliefs that truly drive behaviour.

items.label: Artefacts
items.detail: visible: dress, office layout, stories, rituals

items.label: Basic underlying assumptions
items.detail: invisible, taken for granted, and decisive
